result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem with truncated scrollable content and a minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: Horizontally scrollable sections (restaurant cards in 'Fastest near you' and category filters) show cut-off content on the right side without clear visual indicators that more content is available. The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' is partially hidden, and additional category options appear to extend beyond the visible area.
issues.suggestion: Add visual scroll indicators such as a fade-out gradient overlay on the right edge, scroll arrows, or dots/indicators to clearly signal that horizontal scrolling is available. Alternatively, implement a carousel control mechanism.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears to be truncated and incomplete, likely should be 'Trattoria Piccola' or similar full name.
issues.suggestion: Display the complete restaurant name or implement proper text truncation with an ellipsis ('...') if space is limited. Ensure all business names are fully visible or properly indicated as truncated.
